patch_description:
This version improves the expensive balanced-packing stage while retaining the original public API and output formats.

Key changes:
- Replaces per-item tensor scalar operations and repeated Python linear scans with a heap-based least-loaded-pack assignment. This reduces pack selection from O(num_packs) per item to O(log(num_packs)).
- Processes each layer using Python-native numeric lists after a vectorized Torch sort, avoiding costly repeated CPU tensor indexing.
- Adds a bounded local swap refinement after greedy packing. The refinement preserves the exact number of items in every pack while reducing maximum pack load and load range when beneficial.
- Keeps replication allocation vectorized in Torch, preserving the original greedy replica policy that minimizes the largest logical-expert load per replica.
- Preserves hierarchical/global fallback behavior, tensor shapes, dtypes, mappings, and output semantics.

The local refinement is intentionally bounded, providing better GPU/node packing balance without making the algorithm expensive enough to outweigh inference-time gains.
